summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a securities purchase agreement dated April 15, 2026, under which an institutional investor purchased 12,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.207 per share, for aggregate proceeds of $2,484,000. The transaction closed on April 29, 2026. The filing mentions forward-looking risks regarding Nasdaq approval and closing conditions. Given this is a private placement of equity by the issuer for capital-raising purposes (overhang), it is classified as Other, as it does not meet a special-situations category like a standard PIPE or offering would be captured under 'Rights Offerings'.
